baseline_models.mechanism: Edible substance from an air-mobile creature is delivered according to the eater's inward inclination.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary flesh supplies the literal edible object and keeps the model materially grounded.
Feeding meat and provision from a hunt supplies the delivery relation rather than mere object description.
Bird flight and aerial lightness identify the source creature and contrast its mobility with served flesh.
The soul's inclination supplies the demand signal governing which provision appears.

changed_reading.before: A generic serving of bird meat.
changed_reading.after: Provision is individualized: desired bird flesh arrives as an answer to inward appetite.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The material sequence from طَيْرٍ to لَحْمِ under يَشْتَهُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Desire draws a creature marked by lightness and dispersal into joined, embodied nourishment.

activation_trace.role: Spreading after lightness supplies the mobile, dispersive pole of the material movement.
Joining and adhering separated matter supplies the cohesive pole embodied as flesh.
Inward inclination directs the movement from dispersal toward personally fitting nourishment.

changed_reading.before: Bird names only the species of meat.
changed_reading.after: Bird and flesh form a compact transformation from aerial dispersal to desired bodily coherence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening disassembles massive solidity into scattered dust; the focus clause answers with the counter-motion of mobile life becoming cohesive nourishment.

activation_trace.role: Crushing, moistening, and mixing supplies the destructive processing of mountain mass.
Fine dispersed dust supplies the particulate result of that processing.
Active scattering supplies the outward directional arrow of the opening sequence.
Bird-associated spreading keeps mobility and dispersal present inside the focus clause.
Adhesion and repair supply the reverse motion into coherent flesh.

structural_cues: 56:5-6 moves from mountains through pulverization to dispersed dust, whereas 56:21 names cohesive flesh from an airborne creature.
The focus clause stands inside the provision sequence that follows the cosmic dismantling and sorting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed material images of crushing, scattering, flight, and adhesion; I infer that the feast locally reverses the opening's dispersal. The live alternative is simple contrast without a deliberate reversal.

changed_reading.before: Bird meat is one luxury in a menu.
changed_reading.after: Bird flesh becomes a small-scale sign of reconstituted materiality: dispersed mobility is gathered into sustaining form.

context_deltas.mechanism: An assembled group on interwoven supports, positioned face-to-face, activates flesh as both woven material and kin-like bond; shared eating helps cohere the company.

activation_trace.role: A gathered company supplies the social plurality that can be bound through commensality.
Tightly interwoven construction supplies the material pattern for cohesion.
Mutual facing supplies the reciprocal geometry of the gathered diners.
The weft of cloth transfers the interwoven pattern into the focus word for flesh.
Kinship and allegiance supply a social bond that shared flesh can enact.

structural_cues: The sequence gathers a company, seats them on woven couches face-to-face, circulates service among them, and only then lists the food.
The meal is grammatically coordinated within a common service scene rather than assigned to isolated diners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, interweaving, facing, and flesh branches of weaving and kinship; I infer that commensality performs social cohesion. The alternative is that furniture, posture, and food are parallel luxuries with no causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Each diner privately receives a desired delicacy.
changed_reading.after: Desired flesh also belongs to a face-to-face communal fabric, joining companions through a shared provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Motion migrates from quarry to service: attendants circle the diners, while the bird is already present as flesh, so fulfillment no longer depends on pursuit.

activation_trace.role: Circling around a center locates active movement in the attendants' service route.
Flight supplies the source creature's expected mobility, which the served form suspends.
Meat-feeding and hunting provision supply the delivery relation whose pursuit stage is absent.
Inward desire replaces pursuit as the effective selector of what reaches the diner.

structural_cues: The immediate service unit gives the motion verb to attendants in 56:17, then presents vessels, fruit, and flesh as delivered objects in 56:18-21.
The focus clause contains no verb of chasing, capture, or killing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circular service, bird flight, and meat as hunting provision; I infer a transfer of logistical agency from eater and quarry to service. The alternative is that يطوف governs drink service only.

changed_reading.before: Bird meat tacitly retains the earthly sequence of chase, capture, and preparation.
changed_reading.after: The desired result arrives without pursuit; movement belongs to care and delivery rather than predation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Freedom from headache and depletion protects agency, while the parallel fruit and flesh clauses distinguish reflective choosing from affective desire.

activation_trace.role: Headache supplies the expressly negated impairment, leaving the following acts of selection lucid.
Pleasant fruit supplies the comparison item governed by deliberate choice.
Seeking the better through choice supplies reflective discrimination beside appetite.
The soul's inclination supplies affective wanting as a distinct but unimpaired mode of agency.

structural_cues: 56:19 negates head fracture and, through branchless ن ز ف at word 5, depletion or intoxication immediately before choosing and desiring.
56:20-21 repeat مِمَّا with imperfect plural verbs while switching from يَتَخَيَّرُونَ to يَشْتَهُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated impairment and a tightly parallel lexical switch; I infer that choice and desire are complementary, non-collapsed faculties. The live alternative is stylistic variation with no intended psychology.

changed_reading.after: The appetite is lucid and specifically affective, set beside but not confused with deliberate selection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following recompense clause places desire-responsive provision inside a reciprocal economy: intentional work precedes and is answered by fitting enjoyment.

activation_trace.role: An act answered by its recompense supplies the reciprocal relation governing the listed gifts.
Intentional action supplies the prior human input to which the provision responds.
Fed meat and hunting provision supply the concrete benefit received.
Inward inclination makes the recompense fitting rather than merely equivalent in quantity.

structural_cues: جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ follows the coordinated catalog of couches, drink, fruit, flesh, and companions as its retrospective rationale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, intentional action, provision, and desire; I infer that 56:24 scopes backward over the focus gift. The alternative is a looser summary of the whole scene without a specific desire-to-deed relation.

changed_reading.before: Desire is fulfilled automatically and without history.
changed_reading.after: Fulfilled desire is a tailored answer within a history of intentional action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing acoustic regime filters out waste and moral delay, then doubles peace; this weakens latent extensions of flesh into battle, bird into agitation, and desire into escalation.

activation_trace.role: Discarded, unreckoned material supplies the type of residue excluded from the fulfilled scene.
Delay from the good supplies the moral drag explicitly denied after enjoyment.
Uttered speech supplies the channel through which the scene's final condition is made audible.
Peace as the opposite of war directly counters the battle extension latent in flesh.
Killing and battle expose a violent branch that the peaceful close contains rather than activates.
Unleashed agitation supplies a possible affective excess that the close suppresses.
Craving after craving supplies the escalation model weakened by the sequence's residue-free peace.

structural_cues: After the desire clause, 56:25 uses paired negation and 56:26 an exception followed by doubled سَلَامًا.
The scene repeatedly removes harmful aftermath: no headache or depletion before the food, then no futile or sin-bearing speech after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies violent, agitated, and iterative appetite branches together with an explicit peace-against-war close; I infer that the close constrains those latent extensions. The alternative is that 56:25-26 regulates speech only and does not retroact on appetite.

changed_reading.before: Desired flesh can carry implications of conquest, agitation, or appetite that perpetually renews itself.
changed_reading.after: Nourishment remains, but predatory and escalating extensions are weakened by a scene designed to leave only peace, not harmful residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a bird-landing branch inside the cosmic event root. It remains valid as an imagistic echo because 56:1 supplies that exact branch and 56:21 explicitly supplies bird and flesh; downstream prose should not claim that ٱلْوَاقِعَة means a bird landing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: طَيْرٍ becomes materially landed as لَحْمِ.

activation_trace.role: A bird's landing and landing place miniaturize the opening event as arrival from flight.
Aerial flight supplies the trajectory whose endpoint the landing image requires.
Literal flesh supplies the bird's stable, embodied endpoint in the focus clause.

changed_reading.before: The opening event and the later bird meat are unrelated scales of description.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, the desired flesh makes cosmic وقوع intimate: flight reaches a landing place in embodied provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ج ز ز mapping for QAC ج ز ي and crosses reward into harvest. It remains anchored through the following recompense clause and the focus branch of stripping flesh from bone; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, never as the lexical meaning of جَزَاءً.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَحْمِ as flesh made available by stripping or cutting.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant fruit supplies an edible field in which ripeness and harvest can operate.
The time of cutting at ripeness supplies a harvest-stage image for recompense.
Stripping flesh from bone supplies the focus-side material operation of making food available.
Inward inclination makes the harvested yield personally fitting rather than mechanically paid.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an external payment attached after the meal.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the desired meal is the ripe, cuttable yield of prior action.

strongest_changes: The fruit/flesh parallel differentiates lucid reflective choice from lucid affective desire.
The recompense clause places personalized appetite inside a history of intentional action.
Cosmic dispersal is locally countered by bird mobility cohering as sustaining flesh.
Circulating service removes pursuit from the provision and relocates movement into care.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause became a hinge between opposite material motions and between distinct modes of agency: flight and scattering become cohesion, while choice and desire remain differentiated without impairment.
remaining_uncertainties: The choice/desire contrast may be deliberate semantic calibration or only rhetorical variation.
The backward scope assigned to recompense and peace is structurally plausible but not forced by the focus clause alone.
The landing and harvest outliers are branch-triggered analogies, not lexical substitutions.
